lots.title: Provision of Cleaning Services - Corporate Buildings & Public facilities in Parks & Open Spaces
lots.description: Lot 6 of Framework 6278 (London Borough of Bexley Building Services Framework). Draft Terms and Conditions governing the supply of cleaning services in Council Buildings by a Contractor to The Mayor and Burgesses of the London Borough of Bexley. The Services, their Premises, Key Personnel, KPIs, Service Credits and monitoring arrangements are defined by reference to Schedule 1 (Specification), which is a stub in this draft and must be supplied as a separate specification pack. The T&Cs establish the contracting relationship, quality regime (BSI / ISO Quality Standards and Good Industry Practice), staffing and DBS regime, insurance minima, data-protection Controller/Processor split (Council = Controller, Contractor = Processor), Best Value duty, TUPE risk allocation and standard statutory/commercial obligations (Bribery Act 2010, Public Contracts Regulations 2015, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, Equality Act 2010, Electronic Invoicing Regulations 2019, Local Government Act 1999). Template contract period shown on the front matter is 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2023; the authoritative commencement date and financial value for Framework 6278 are governed by the tender notice and Form of Contract insert fields.
requirements: Supply the Services during the Contract Period in accordance with the Council's requirements as set out in the Specification and the provisions of the Contract (clause B1.1).

If any part of the Services does not meet contractual requirements, re-schedule and re-perform the affected Services at the Contractor's own expense within a reasonable time specified by the Council (clause B1.2).
Treat timely supply of the Services as of the essence, including commencing the supply on the specified date (clause B1.3).
Permit the Council to inspect and examine how the Services are supplied at the Premises during normal business hours on reasonable notice (clause B1.4).

Provide all Equipment necessary for the Services; do not deliver Equipment to the Premises without the Council's prior written approval; maintain Equipment in a safe, serviceable and clean condition; cease and replace Equipment which is hazardous, noxious or non-compliant on written request; remove Equipment on completion (clauses B2.1-B2.6).

Comply with the Quality Standards (BSI / ISO and equivalents) at all times, maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body where applicable, and where not specified in Contract, agree the relevant Services standard with the Council and perform in accordance with the Law and Good Industry Practice (clause B3.1).
Ensure all Staff perform with due skill, care and diligence and possess the qualifications, skills and experience necessary for the proper supply of the Services (clause B3.2).
Employ sufficient persons (including a sufficient reserve) to ensure the Service is provided at all times throughout the Contract Period, including any extension (clause B4.1).

Ensure Staff are competent, skilled, honest and experienced, suitably qualified to drive/operate vehicles or equipment, and wear full uniform or appropriate safety/identification clothing which is clean and presentable (clause B4.2).

Register with the Disclosure and Barring Service and undertake DBS checks at the required level for relevant Staff where required by the Specification; re-check at least every three years via new DBS disclosure or DBS Update Service status check; provide DBS policy, records of checks, and a list of Staff with check status at commencement (clauses B4.11 - B4.13).

Ensure no person employed or engaged in the Services is barred from Regulated Activity under the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006; immediately notify the Authorised Officer of any relevant conviction, caution, bindover, DBS barred-list entry, or non-disclosure by Staff (clauses B4.14, B4.17 - B4.18).
Confirm all Staff are lawfully entitled to live and work in the United Kingdom (clause B4.8).

Appoint a suitably qualified, competent and English-fluent Contract Manager in full charge of the Services, continuously available during operating hours, and empowered to act on the Contractor's behalf; notify the Authorised Officer in writing of the Contract Manager's and deputy's identity, addresses, phone and email (clauses B6.1 - B6.2).

Identify and propose continuous Service improvements (Best Value) under the Local Government Act 1999, including technology advances, quality/performance improvements, third-party interface improvements and process changes, and participate in Council benchmarking reviews (clauses B8.1 - B8.3).

Accept payment of the Contract Price, which remains fixed for the Contract Period subject to Clause C4; submit invoices in electronic form where required via the Tungsten Network, compliant with the standard on electronic invoicing under the Public Procurement (Electronic Invoices etc.) Regulations 2019 (clauses C1.1 - C1.4).

Invoice monthly in arrears; Council to pay undisputed sums within 30 days of receipt of a valid invoice; include detailed breakdown and applicable Service Credit deductions on each invoice (clauses C2.1 - C2.2).

Include in any sub-contract a 30-day payment term for undisputed sums and publishable compliance obligation; pay sub-contractors within 30 days of a valid invoice and certify compliance quarterly at director level (clauses C2.6 - C2.7).
Not commit Prohibited Acts (bribery, fraud, inducement or reward to Council personnel) nor have any member of Staff do so; comply with the Bribery Act 2010 (clauses D1, Definitions 'Prohibited Act').
Not unlawfully discriminate and comply with Equality Act 2010 and the Council's equality and diversity policies (clause D3).
Comply with environmental requirements set out in the Specification (clause D5).

Comply with health and safety Law and the Council's health and safety measures/policies at the Premises; ensure chemicals/solutions used for the Services comply with any Specification requirements, are used strictly per manufacturer instructions, are safe for site users, conform to relevant British/European standards, and chemicals have full HSE or Environment Agency approval (clauses D6.1 - D6.4).

Act as Processor to the Council's Controller under UK GDPR / DPA 2018 for Personal Data under the Contract; only process Personal Data in accordance with Schedule 1 and Council instructions; apply appropriate Protective Measures (encryption, pseudonymisation, confidentiality/integrity/availability/resilience, restorability); assist with DSARs and DPIAs; notify the Council promptly of Personal Data Breaches (clauses E1.1 - E1.15).

Treat Council Data and Confidential Information as confidential; comply with FOIA and EIRs, including responding to Requests for Information within 5 Working Days and transferring such requests to the Council where appropriate (clauses E3 - E4).

Maintain for the duration of the Contract public and third party liability and product liability insurance of not less than GBP 5 million per claim; employer's liability insurance of not less than GBP 5 million per incident where the Contractor employs fewer than 100 people and not less than GBP 10 million per claim where it employs 100 or more people; and where required by the nature of the Services, professional indemnity insurance of not less than GBP 2 million per incident (clauses G1.6 - G1.7).

Maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than GBP 2,000,000 per claim (including for agents, consultants and sub-contractors where involved in the Services) for a minimum of 6 years after expiry or earlier termination (clause G2).

Perform Services for three defined milestone / contractual stages per the Form of Contract template commencement 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2023 with possible extension per Clause F8; authoritative dates are specified in the Form of Contract insert fields (Whereas A; clauses A2, F8).

Meet KPIs specified in Schedule 4 to the Specification; comply with Notices to Remedy under Section 18 of the Specification; submit Management Reports on KPIs as required by Schedule 4 to the Specification and attend meetings with the Authorised Officer at the frequency set out in the Specification (clauses F5.1 - F5.4, F7.1 - F7.2).
Not transfer or sub-contract the whole or any part of the Contract without prior written consent of the Council, except sub-contracts in the ordinary course (clause F1 and related).

Comply with the Council's security, access, premises and property handling requirements; treat all Council property issued free of charge as remaining the Council's property, return or make available on demand, store separately and identify (clauses B7.1 - B7.5).

Evaluate TUPE risk and cost at its own expense; indemnify the Council against all TUPE-related claims by former Contractor staff; on re-letting, supply staff data to the Council for disclosure to other Contractors within 21 days of request, at no cost; not artificially reorganise workforce or amend employment terms near expiry to frustrate TUPE or other bidders (clauses S1.1 - S1.7).

Resolve disputes through good-faith negotiation escalated to Chief Executives, then mediation via CEDR unless unsuitable, before any referral to the exclusive jurisdiction of the English Courts (clauses I1 - I2).
